freeze_rule: Freeze (status FROZEN, seeds allocated, commit) before any state is collected on the confirmatory block. Smoke on 999xxxxx only.
classification: Causal intervention on the strategy input of the shared student. Read-only; no training.
question: In Fully Shared+z+r, with observation and role held fixed, does changing only z change the action distribution, and does it move it toward the matching teacher (z=A toward Ours-A, z=B toward Ours-B)? I.e. does z control strategy rather than act as decorative metadata?

subject.mechanism: rl/custom_ppo/inference_policy.CustomPPOInferencePolicy.get_distribution(obs, z_idx=...) on the SAME observation dict (roles attached as in eval_suite_sharing_crossover), once with z_idx = 0 (A) and once with z_idx = 1 (B)

teachers_reference.what: 2v2 Ours dual-branch composites (pins as BEHAVIOR_SIGNATURES_2V2_V1); per agent, the teacher distribution is the branch its role selects (DEFEND -> pi_X final, ATTACK -> exported attack branch)
teachers_reference.use: direction test only; teachers are evaluated on the identical observations

state_collection.rollouts: the student itself, natural episodes, z in {A, B} x pole in {A, B}, 32 seeds each (128 episodes); every decision tick is a probe state
state_collection.why_both_z: probe states come from both strategies' own visitation so neither z is favoured by the state distribution

metrics_frozen.S1_divergence: per agent per state: Jensen-Shannon divergence between pi(.|o,r,z=A) and pi(.|o,r,z=B), summed over the action heads (macro, target); averaged over agents and states
metrics_frozen.S2_argmax_flip: fraction of agent-states where the deterministic (argmax) joint action differs between z=A and z=B
metrics_frozen.S3_direction_A: mean over states of JSD(pi_s(z=A), T_A) - JSD(pi_s(z=A), T_B); negative = z=A sits closer to teacher A
metrics_frozen.S4_direction_B: mean over states of JSD(pi_s(z=B), T_B) - JSD(pi_s(z=B), T_A); negative = z=B sits closer to teacher B
metrics_frozen.S5_teacher_scale: mean JSD(T_A, T_B) on the same states, so S1 can be read as a fraction of the teachers' own A-B difference

analysis_frozen.uncertainty: episode-clustered bootstrap (resample episodes, n = 20000, rng 7); states within an episode are not independent
analysis_frozen.breakdown: every metric reported overall and per (collection z, pole) cell and per role (ATTACK / DEFEND)
analysis_frozen.decision_rule: z is causally effective when the S1 interval excludes 0 AND S3 < 0 AND S4 < 0 with intervals excluding 0. Effective but not teacher-directed (S1 > 0 without S3/S4) is reported as such.
analysis_frozen.trajectory_level: trajectory consequences of forcing z come from BEHAVIOR_SIGNATURES_2V2_V1 (its Fully Shared+z+r arm); not duplicated here
analysis_frozen.reporting: mean effects with 95% intervals; no metric dropped

depends_on: nothing; runs after the 4v4 Stage-4 chain finishes (user ordering)
